name: q2_largest_filers_share
title: Cumulative share held by the largest assignees
caption: The named assignees ranked by unique aircraft, largest first, and the cumulative share of the aircraft they hold, cut into four bands.
read: The curve climbs by one assignee at a time; the bands A to D cut it where assignees hold 10 or more, 5-9, 2-4 and 1 aircraft each; the dashed line is the share all named assignees hold.
